last_cycle_outcome: H73 KILLED at the SCREEN. The exact-gain sift's argmax TIE-BREAK: replace 'leftmost gap of the optimal plateau' with 'maximizing gap nearest the current rank'. NOTHING PROMOTED - sota.json untouched. THE PREMISE IS TRUE AND PERVASIVE AND THE PIPELINE DOES NOT CARE, and that pair is the result. PROTOTYPE (CPU, 94 s, experiments/outputs/proto_H73_connectome.json) passed the item's 1% free pre-gate by two orders of magnitude: 95.0-99.7% of stage-3 movers sit on an exact-optimal plateau of width > 1, median width 574-1646 ranks, mean up to 4846. The new rule redirects 44.0-74.9% of movers and cuts mean transport by 800-4961 ranks each, FOR THE SAME EXACT GAIN. SCREEN (6/6 clean, 63 min GPU): connectome 84.25590809116623 on all 3 seeds bit-identical = -0.002271418 pp vs the H64 champion 84.25817950936937, i.e. 19% of the 0.012 bar and on the wrong side of zero, so the item's own two-sided kill condition is literally met. THE MECHANISM OF THE NULL IS MEASURED, not assumed, from per-stage attribution in the run records: stage 2 identical (83.23791666953974 both - the change is confined to stages 3-4 as designed); STAGE 3 GETS WORSE by -0.018505378 pp (84.11761164861514 -> 84.09910627090132); STAGE 4's increment GROWS by +0.016233960 pp (0.14056786 -> 0.15680182), giving back 87.7% of it. NOTE THE SIGN - IT IS OPPOSITE TO THE HYPOTHESIS: the leftward over-transport is load-bearing FOR THE SIFT, so 'first' is the BETTER stage-3 rule by more than the bar, and the open direction is MORE transport, not less (filed as H77, which the item's own kill_condition required be filed as a new hypothesis rather than a re-run). ALSO FALSIFIED: the item predicted 'runtime-neutral, which matters under P19'; H73 costs 1253.3 s vs 1184.0 s (+5.8%), sift +9.7%, alternation +9.0%. NEW META-RULE M14-plateau-transport-is-absorbed: where inside the optimal plateau a mover is sent is not load-bearing for the final score because stage 4 absorbs it - any item that changes a move's DESTINATION without changing its exact GAIN must show it survives stage 4, and the cheap diagnostic needs no new code (read sift_best_pct next to alt_increment_pp in the run JSONs). M14 also SCOPES M5: M5-no-ties is about CONTINUOUS position ties and does NOT generalise to the discrete profile, where plateaus are pervasive - the ties are real, they are just worth nothing. MOUSE LEG NOT PROMOTED, DELIBERATELY: H73 scores 93.18415504034846 on mouse, 3/3 bit-identical, +0.008772 pp over the H63 champion, but the screen gate failed as a whole so there is no confirm and no critic behind it, mouse is supporting-only, and promoting it would make the mouse champion carry a knob measured to hurt connectome that every future variant would inherit. Filed as H76 with that objection stated. PROCESS: critic not run, per the ladder for a screen kill (precedent cycles 10-13). The tie_break keyword STAYS in the tree - it defaults to 'first', 5 tests in tests/test_H73_tiebreak.py pin the champions' bit-reproducibility on that default (incl. a brute-force profile enumeration), H73(first) reproduces H64 bit-identically through all six stages, and the module was COMMITTED BEFORE THE SCREEN (5536619) for the third cycle running. Full suite 611 passed. P23 WAS CHECKED FIRST as cycle 19 instructed and is STILL awaiting-operator - HEAD was 4f6e2d1, no ruling on the branch - so H70/H74 stay blocked and this cycle took the unblocked connectome axis. New items H76, H77.

notes: CHAMPIONS UNCHANGED: connectome H64 84.2582, microns H42 83.2409, mouse H63 93.1754. *** DIVERGENT MODE IS NOW ARMED: cycles_since_score_move = 3, which MEETS escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move. THE NEXT CYCLE MUST RUN IN DIVERGENT MODE AND AN INFRASTRUCTURE ITEM WILL NOT SATISFY IT. *** That is the single most important line in this file and cycle 19 predicted it exactly. What divergent mode requires, per the skill: stop proposing variants of the current design, write reasoning to autoresearch/lit/ BEFORE proposing anything, re-read experiments/diagnosis.md Q01/Q02, and attack a different level - move class, decomposition, or the problem formulation itself. cycles_since_literature_scan = 2 (scan fires at 5), but a scout run is part of divergent mode regardless of that counter. NEXT CYCLE, IN ORDER. (a) CHECK P23 FIRST, for the fourth cycle running - it is still the campaign's blocker and still the operator's. Its option B (measure only H42's microns relabelling dispersion, 5 unguarded runs, ~4.9 h) is the number nobody has and it decides H70, H63, H74 and every future microns variant at once. If a ruling has appeared, that outranks divergence: it unblocks a CONFIRMED result (H70) rather than a speculative one. (b) OTHERWISE GO DIVERGENT. Do NOT take H77 - it is the opposite-sign branch of the item just killed, which is precisely 'another variant of the current design', and M14 makes it a long shot by construction. Do NOT take H76 (mouse-only, supporting dataset, and its own entry argues against promotion). Both are filed for completeness, not as the next move. (c) READ M14 BEFORE SCHEDULING ANYTHING ON THE REFINEMENT STACK. It kills a whole family for free: any item that changes a move's DESTINATION without changing its exact GAIN is absorbed by stage 4 at 87.7%. Check H61 (k-node joint re-insertion), H71 (subset-bipartition tuck) and H72 (minimum-backward-crossing SCC cut) against it before spending a cycle - H71 and H72 change the gain, so M14 does not bind on them, but the ABSORPTION diagnostic (one run each, read sift_best_pct next to alt_increment_pp) is now the cheapest way to predict any of them and it costs no new code. (d) THE DEEPER READING OF M14, WORTH ONE CYCLE OF THOUGHT: stage 4 absorbed 87.7% of a deliberate perturbation, and cycle 19 found the champion order is a strict local maximum along the ASYM gradient with EXACTLY 0.000000 pp of repair headroom. Those are two independent measurements of the same thing - the refinement stack is at a joint fixed point that is robust to how it got there. That is an argument for attacking the DECOMPOSITION or the FORMULATION rather than the refiner, which is exactly what divergent mode is for. CALIBRATION, unchanged: the FlyWire leaderboard has not moved since 2026-01-09; H64's +0.104084 pp overtook ZERO entries; the nearest rung is Hashorva at 84.37753%, +0.11935 pp above us. LP/SDP rounding for linear ordering is a dead axis and should never be searched again.
_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
